schedule.caveat: Link schedule times may already include dwell; bounded stop dwell adds time. Passenger-dependent dwell is intentionally omitted by the simulation owner. This is a residual, not an observed accuracy estimate.

demand.caveat: Whole-route, both-direction, all-day November 2025 boardings cannot validate a westbound two-hour segment. Modeled event total also includes warm-up and clearance.

held_out_headways.caveat: No held-out weekday vehicle observations were supplied; GTFS is scheduled service.

limitations: No stop-level demand or incoming-occupancy calibration.
